cap:info.cap:headline: River Ganga at Farakka in Murshidabad district of West Bengal continues to flow in severe flood situation at 6:00 pm today.
cap:info.cap:description: River Ganga at Farakka in Murshidabad district of West Bengal continues to flow in severe flood situation at 6:00 pm today. At 6:00 pm, it was flowing at a level of 22.78 m with rising trend which is 0.53 m above its Danger Level of 22.25 m and 2.35 m below its previous HFL of 25.13 m (07/09/1998).
